evals.prompt: Generate a multi-page financial summary PDF from Markdown/ReportLab and verify its final layout.
evals.expected_output: Generate from editable source, embed fonts, repeat table headers, run pdfinfo and qpdf --check, render every page with pdftoppm, visually inspect every page, and bind verification to the exact final PDF.
expectations: Generates PDF from editable source without hand-patching
Renders every page to images and visually inspects for clipping or dead gaps
Runs pdfinfo/qpdf checks on the exact final artifact

evals.prompt: Fill out an AcroForm PDF application without altering unfilled fields.
evals.expected_output: Read references/forms.md, detect fillable fields with scripts/check_fillable_fields.py, populate matching field IDs, preserve unfilled fields, and render/inspect every filled page.
expectations: Detects fillable fields before choosing form-filling path
Preserves unfilled fields and verifies checkbox/choice states visually
